headline: ELECTION ANALYSIS
subheadline: CAN DANIEL URRESTI JOIN THE GROUP OF MOST POPULAR CANDIDATES?
author: Ricardo Vasquez Kunze, Political Analyst, Editor-in-Chief of politico.pe
content: It seems unlikely given his return amidst declining nationalistic candidate credibility. Frequent shifts among proposed candidates have led to skepticism about their seriousness regarding future elections. Without forming alliances, particularly with groups close to former President Alejandro Toledo’s Peru Possible party, surpassing election thresholds remains improbable. Nationalism presents chaotic proposals leading citizens away from voting for this group despite reintroducing figures like Daniel Urresti. Outsider options might compete against him, including Cesar Acuna.
